title: Flash silhouette: two profiles in gold light, then a glowing heart
summary: Turn a side-by-side photo of you and your partner, friend or pet into a moody black clip with gold rim light, a camera flash and a glowing heart.
why: Remake the Trend's AI video list, updated November 17, 2026, added "Flash Couple Silhouette" on November 16: two profiles face each other on a black background with gold rim light, a flash goes off, and a glowing white heart floats up between them.
steps: Use a photo where you and the other person (or your pet) face each other side-on. A plain background works best. Only use someone who has agreed.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with your photo. Ask for 5 to 8 seconds.
Make a few versions. Keep the one where both faces still look like you and the heart rises slowly and cleanly.
Add a soft, slow track from your app's sound library.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the couple silhouette
prompts.text: Animate this photo as an 8-second vertical clip. The two people face each other in profile against a pure black background. Their faces and hair are lit only by a thin, warm gold rim light along the edges, so they look almost like silhouettes. They lean in slightly and smile. Then a bright camera flash fills the frame for a split second. As the flash fades, a soft glowing white heart appears between them and floats slowly upward. Slow, calm, romantic mood. Keep both faces true to the photo. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: best friends
prompts.text: Animate this photo as an 8-second vertical clip. Two friends face each other in profile on a black background, edged with warm gold rim light. They hold a serious, dramatic face, then both break into a laugh at the same moment. A quick camera flash goes off, and a small glowing white heart pops up between them and drifts away. Moody lighting, playful ending. Keep both faces true to the photo. No text.

prompts.label: Variation: you and your pet
prompts.text: Animate this photo as an 8-second vertical clip. Me and my pet face each other in profile against a black background, both outlined in a soft gold rim light. My pet tilts its head, then gives my nose a little nudge. A camera flash pops, and a glowing white heart floats up between us. Gentle, sweet mood. Keep my face and my pet's markings exactly as in the photo. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: the perfect pair
prompts.text: Animate this photo as an 8-second vertical clip. Two of my products stand side by side on a black background, each outlined in a thin gold rim light. The camera slowly pushes in. A bright camera flash fills the frame, and as it fades a glowing white heart rises between the two products. Elegant and calm, like a gift ad. Keep both products, their shapes and labels exactly as in the photo. No new logos, no extra text.

tips: Side-on photos work best. If you only have a front photo, ask the tool to "turn both heads to face each other in profile" and check the faces closely.
If the whole picture goes bright, ask for "a thin gold rim light only, the rest stays black".
The business version suits gift sets and "perfect pair" bundles for the holidays.
Say it's made with AI in your caption.
